description: The agent tools of fabric-desktop/1 (plan section 9.2). Each tool is a method of the agent channel; `arguments` names its argument schema. `creates_request` is false only for the status tool, which reads safe lifecycle metadata. `rows` lists the policy-matrix rows a call may fall under; it is informative, and the rule theory decides. No tool approves a request, creates a grant, edits a profile, deletes a calendar, changes sharing, reads a warning, or passes a URL to Google.

tools.name: fabric_calendar_list
tools.description: List the Google accounts and calendars this agent may use, with each calendar's access level. Use the returned account_id and calendar_id values in other tools.

tools.name: fabric_calendar_availability
tools.description: Read busy intervals for calendars in one account over a date window. Returns times only, never event details.

tools.name: fabric_calendar_read
tools.description: Read events in calendars of one account over a date window. Name only the fields you need; a field the owner has not granted comes back as null.

tools.name: fabric_calendar_propose_create
tools.description: Propose a new timed event with no attendees. Give start and end as a local date-time with its UTC offset and an IANA time zone. To invite people, create the event first and then propose an invitation.

tools.name: fabric_calendar_propose_update
tools.description: Propose changes to the title, time, description or location of one non-recurring event, against the revision you read. Set a field to null to leave it as it is.

tools.name: fabric_calendar_propose_invitation
tools.description: Propose the complete attendee list for one non-recurring event and who is notified. Google and the attendees see the event's details.

tools.name: fabric_calendar_propose_response
tools.description: Propose accepting or declining an invitation: a single event, or one occurrence of a recurring invitation named by its instance id, original start time and revision. The organizer may be notified.

tools.name: fabric_calendar_propose_delete
tools.description: Propose deleting one event that Fabric created. The owner is always asked.

tools.name: fabric_request_status
tools.description: Read the state of a request you made. Returns lifecycle state only, never calendar content.

tools.name: fabric_request_result
tools.description: Ask for the result of a request you made, once it has been approved and applied. Releasing a result is itself checked, and may need the owner's approval again.
